document.title: A cleaner, clearer review UI, polished until three design reviewers scored it 8.5+
document.summary: The change restyles every screen of the review UI on a set of shared controls, adds a sidebar collapse button and a favicon logo, shows the commit summary in blame, and adds `pnpm ui:screenshots` to shoot 6 reference screenshots of a real review.
document.why: The review UI should impress a professional designer with how clean and clear it is: easy to use and easy on the eyes [design hill-climb](source:s2).

sources.label: PR #181
sources.title: A cleaner, clearer review UI, polished until three design reviewers scored it 8.5+
sources.gist: Polishes every screen until three design reviewers each scored it at least 8.5/10; adds reproducible screenshots, a favicon logo, sidebar collapse, blame summaries, and "Things to check" copy.

sources.label: Claude Code session · Nov 4
sources.gist: Máté asks for a screenshot-driven design hill-climb scored by a council, then for the favicon as the logo, an easy sidebar collapse button, an Ask agent control that looks like a button, a fixed agent prompt, and a smaller diff.

lookFor: The [session](source:s2) asks to "fix the agent prompt as well". The only prompt change is the label: `lookForBlock` in `src/api/agent-md.ts` prints `Things to check:` in place of `Look for:`. The rest of the prompt text is the same as on base.

The [session](source:s2) asks to handle the rest of the follow-ups from the last design review. Wrapped code lines still restart at column 0, with no hanging indent. The session gives the reason: Pierre's CSS cannot indent a wrapped line to match its leading spaces.
Manual step: `CONTRIBUTING.md` says to run `pnpm exec playwright install chromium` once per machine before `pnpm ui:screenshots`. Without it, `chromium.launch` fails and the script exits with code 1.

groups.title: Shared controls and tokens
groups.why: Enables the shell, brief, files, and diff groups: they use these controls, so one control looks and acts the same on every screen.
groups.summary: The new `Segmented`, `ViewedToggle`, and `DiffStat` components and the extra `Badge` and menu variants draw on the colour tokens in `styles.css`, which the later groups reuse.

fileNotes.src/ui/components/ui/badge.tsx: Adds `new`, `changed`, and `ref` variants and a small size.
fileNotes.src/ui/components/ui/dropdown-menu.tsx: Item, checkbox item, and separator styles for the Display menu.
fileNotes.src/ui/components/ui/resizable.tsx: The grip shows only on hover, focus, or drag.

fileNotes.src/ui/components/ViewedToggle.tsx: New Viewed checkbox with its `v` key hint.
fileNotes.src/ui/lib/reading-progress.ts: Labels count viewed files: `1/3`, `1 of 3 files viewed`.
fileNotes.src/ui/lib/scroll-edges.ts: New hook that marks a scroller with more content past an edge.
fileNotes.src/ui/lib/scroll-edges.test.ts: Tests the edge flags on both axes.
fileNotes.src/ui/styles.css: Colour tokens and the part strand palette for both themes.
fileNotes.src/ui/lib/ThemeProvider.tsx: Removes `toggleTheme`; the theme button sets the preference.

groups.title: Header, sidebar, and navigation
groups.why: Máté asks for the favicon as the app's icon and an easy sidebar collapse button [session](source:s2). The rest of the shell follows the design reviews of the same session.
groups.summary: `Header` holds the favicon `Logo`, the `SidebarButton` that collapses the sidebar panel in `App`, the new `DisplayMenu`, and `GroupNav`, whose arrows follow `neighborSelection` in `selection.ts`.

attention.note: `neighborSelection` in `selection.ts` now walks `groupWalk`, every group of every part. It used to stay inside the current part (`partWalk`, removed). So `]` and the header arrow on a part's last group now open the next part's first group, and `{` and `}` still jump part to part.

questions: Why does the header `SidebarButton` collapse the sidebar without saving it, while a drag-collapse is saved by `useDefaultLayout`?

fileNotes.src/ui/App.tsx: Collapsible sidebar panel, `toggleSidebar`, and the `b` key.
fileNotes.src/ui/components/Header.tsx: Collapse button, `base → head` range, and lighter controls.
fileNotes.src/ui/components/GroupNav.tsx: Adds `NextTitle`, the next group's title beside the arrows.
fileNotes.src/ui/components/DisplayMenu.tsx: New menu for wrap, comments, and theme, with key hints.
fileNotes.src/ui/components/MobileShell.tsx: Uses `DisplayMenu` in place of the old view menu.
fileNotes.src/ui/components/Sidebar.tsx: Part headings with strand dots and short attention marks.
fileNotes.src/ui/components/ReviewStage.tsx: Passes the next group and its title to `Group`.
fileNotes.src/ui/lib/selection.test.ts: Expects the walk to cross parts.

groups.why: Máté says the Ask agent button does not look like a button [session](source:s2). The other brief changes answer the design reviews in the same session.
groups.summary: `Overview` and `GroupBrief` lay out the why, the what, the attention, questions, and sources through the `Kicker` labels and rail, with the outlined `AskAgent` split button beside the title.

fileNotes.src/ui/components/Overview.tsx: Part sections, group rows, and the review size line.
fileNotes.src/ui/components/Group.tsx: Brief rail beside the diff cards and a next-group footer.
fileNotes.src/ui/components/GroupBrief.tsx: Why and What fields, attention, and dependency links.
fileNotes.src/ui/components/Kicker.tsx: Adds `splitAside`, `DisclosureToggle`, and the scroll fade classes.
fileNotes.src/ui/components/Attention.tsx: One icon per kind; `AttentionMark` always adds the short word.
fileNotes.src/ui/components/SourceList.tsx: Sources collapse behind a counted toggle.
fileNotes.src/ui/components/SourceCite.tsx: Larger citation icon, no wrap, and a sans kicker.
fileNotes.src/ui/components/InlineMd.tsx: Adds `InlineCode`, which can break long tokens.
fileNotes.src/ui/lib/inline-md.ts: Adds `codeBreakParts` for break points in code.
fileNotes.src/ui/lib/hyphen-runs.ts: New split that keeps hyphenated words together.
fileNotes.src/ui/components/AskAgent.tsx: Outlined split button; unused icon-only form removed.
fileNotes.src/ui/components/Changes.tsx: New badges and the "Things to check" label.

groups.title: Files list and image cards
groups.why: The design reviews in the [session](source:s2) flag cramped file lists and paths that hide the folder that tells two files apart.
groups.summary: `FileNav` lists a group's files with `repeatedNameFolders` from `file-nav.ts` highlighting the folder that differs, and `ImageDiff` sizes each image card with `image-stage.ts`.
questions: Why does `FileRows` drop the middle cut of long names, so a long name now cuts at its end and can lose its extension?

fileNotes.src/ui/components/FileNav.tsx: Files list with folder lines, mobile chips with borders, j/k hint.
fileNotes.src/ui/lib/file-nav.test.ts: Tests repeated folders and scroll deltas.
fileNotes.src/ui/lib/group-files.ts: Adds `IMAGE_STATUS` labels and tones for image rows.
fileNotes.src/ui/components/ImageDiff.tsx: Cards that hug the image, zoom for all images, scale label.
fileNotes.src/ui/components/ImageDiff.module.css: Drops the hairline; the checker bench stays.
fileNotes.src/ui/lib/image-stage.test.ts: Tests the scale label and fits.

groups.title: Diff cards
groups.why: The design reviews in the [session](source:s2) ask for calmer diff cards and code that is easy to read in both themes.
groups.summary: `HunkView` frames each file's `PierreDiff`, whose CSS strings come from `gap-style.ts`, `syntax-theme.ts`, and the moved-line rules, and whose gaps and focus bars come from `hunk-gaps.ts` and `focus.ts`.

attention.note: `resolveWrap` in `narrow.ts` now returns `true` when no toggle is set; before, only narrow screens wrapped. Long code lines wrap on desktop too, and so do markdown tables, which lose their column alignment. Pierre sets wrap per file, so no file type can opt out.

fileNotes.src/ui/components/HunkView.tsx: Card header; the folder cuts from the start so the last folder stays.
fileNotes.src/ui/PierreDiff.tsx: Moved-line CSS, annotation gutter fix, and the blame stamp.
fileNotes.src/ui/components/FocusBar.tsx: Gap rows that count hidden lines.
fileNotes.src/ui/components/NotePin.tsx: Shared `PinCard` and `PinKicker` for note and comment cards.
fileNotes.src/ui/components/CommentPin.tsx: Uses `PinCard` and splits the body into paragraphs.
fileNotes.src/ui/components/MovedChip.tsx: Icon, slate moved colour, and a `MovedLabel` with text and path.
fileNotes.src/ui/lib/focus.ts: Inlines one-use helpers in the focus bar split.
fileNotes.src/ui/lib/hunk-gaps.ts: New: hidden lines between hunks and gutter digit width.
fileNotes.src/ui/lib/gap-style.ts: Pierre gap and gutter CSS for both themes.
fileNotes.src/ui/lib/syntax-theme.ts: New: recolours syntax tokens to meet contrast in both themes.
fileNotes.src/ui/lib/theme.ts: Points both themes at the recoloured `comprehende-*` syntax themes.

groups.title: Blame shows the commit summary
groups.why: The design reviews in the [session](source:s2) ask for blame runs a reviewer can read without opening each commit. The [PR](source:s1) lists it under Blame.
groups.summary: `parseBlamePorcelain` in `blame.ts` reads each commit's `summary` line, `groupBlameRuns` carries it on each run, and the `BlameStamp` in `PierreDiff.tsx` shows it in the `Inspector` Blame mode.

attention.note: `BlameStamp` shows the summary and the In this review badge only when `meta.inRange`. A run from a commit before base shows its SHA, author, and date, with no summary. The reviewer decides whether older summaries would help or only add noise.

focus.caption: Check which cells depend on `meta.inRange`: the badge and the summary, not the author or the line range.

notes.body: The header pattern now also takes 64-character SHA-256 object names.

fileNotes.src/git/blame.ts: Reads `summary` lines; exports the parser for tests.
fileNotes.src/git/blame.test.ts: New tests for the porcelain parser.
fileNotes.src/server/http.test.ts: Blame payload test expects the summary.
fileNotes.src/ui/components/Inspector.tsx: Version and Mode switches use `Segmented`; In this review legend.

groups.title: "Things to check" in the agent prompt
groups.why: Máté asks to fix the agent prompt as well [session](source:s2): it said "Look for" where the UI says "Things to check".
groups.summary: `lookForBlock` in `agent-md.ts` and the glossary entry now use the UI label "Things to check"; the schema field stays `lookFor`.

fileNotes.docs/glossary.md: Entry renamed; names the `lookFor` schema field.

groups.title: Reproducible UI screenshots
groups.why: Máté asks for reference screenshots that cover the UI and that can run again later [session](source:s2).
groups.summary: `pnpm ui:screenshots` runs `scripts/ui-screenshots.ts`, which builds the UI, rebuilds the `cigster-99` eval repo from its bundle, serves it with the saved review, and shoots 6 scenes with Playwright into the gitignored `fixtures/screenshots/`.

attention.note: `runUiScreenshots` runs `rm` with `recursive` and `force` on `fixtures/screenshot-repos` and on the `--out` folder before every run. `--out` is not checked, so a wrong path deletes that folder and everything in it. The default is the gitignored `fixtures/screenshots`.

fileNotes.scripts/ui-screenshots.ts: New script: the scenes, viewports, settle waits, and repo build.
fileNotes.scripts/ui-screenshots.review.json: A model-written review of `cigster-99`, copied from an eval run.
fileNotes.package.json: Adds the `ui:screenshots` script and the `playwright` dev dependency.
fileNotes..gitignore: Ignores the shots and the rebuilt repos.
fileNotes.CONTRIBUTING.md: How to install Chromium and run the script.

commits.subject: UI: design polish from screenshot reviews
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
- Reproducible screenshots: `pnpm ui:screenshots` shoots 6 desktop and mobile scenes of the cigster-99 eval case with a saved review.
- Header: favicon logo, sidebar collapse button (b), Display menu, prev/next across parts with the next group title.
- Group page: brief rail, Files list with repeated-name folders, outlined Ask agent button, focus bar, note and comment pins.
- Diffs and images: hunk gaps, moved lines, syntax recolour, image cards with stage scale and zoom.
- Inspector blame shows the commit summary for in-review runs.
- Agent prompt and glossary say "Things to check", the UI label.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
